note: Triennial election of the Clogher rural district councillors, 1939. Nominations were received by Mr. J. F. M'Crea, deputy returning officer, and closed on Tuesday 18 April 1939: 'there are to be no contests in the 16 divisions of Clogher Rural District and Board of Guardians' (Ulster Herald, 22 April 1939, p. 5). Twelve divisions had one nomination each; in Ballygawley, Foremass, Errigal and Newtownsaville no nominations were made and the sitting members retained their seats. The only change was Aughnacloy Rural (Robert Elliot for Henry Montgomerry). No party labels are printed. No poll was held; the folder date is the provisional Tyrone polling day. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Aughentaine' to Aghintain (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Clogher Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Aghintain; the rounds were filed as Aughentaine (1899, 1902, 1905, 1908, 1911, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Aughentain (1924). This round was filed as 'Aughentaine', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (aughentaine) answers with a redirect to this one.
